extra.description: Single-cell transcriptomics enables profiling of cellular states at unprecedented resolution, but its high dimensionality, sparsity, and technical batch effects pose significant challenges for representation learning. Existing single-cell foundation models typically encode each cell independently or only model cells from the same batch for denoising, thereby underutilizing the rich relational information across batches and cell types to model gene expression patterns. We argue that single-cell models can benefit from more informative cell-context modeling. By comparing consistency and variation across cells, models can capture fine-grained gene-gene dependencies associated with cell states, which are essential for learning high-quality representations. Inspired by the use of multiple sequence alignment (MSA) context in protein modeling, we propose CellMSA, a single-cell representation learning framework that introduces an MSA-inspired inductive bias into transcriptomic modeling. For each target cell, CellMSA retrieves relevant cells from different batches and biologically related cell types as context, and summarizes cross-cell patterns into a context-dependent gene-pair representation. This representation is then injected into a pair-aware target-cell encoder for fine-grained representation learning. We pretrain CellMSA on a large-scale human single-cell corpus of approximately 109 million cell observations, including 65.6 million primary observations. Experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at the following repository: https://github.com/PharMolix/CellMSA.

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: LIBERO-PeRM：个性化机器人操作基准
items.summary_zh: 个性化对通用机器人进入家庭环境、实现真正实用至关重要。通用机器人操作已被广泛研究，但个性化机器人操作（PeRM）缺乏一个受控基准来区分任务完成与偏好满足。我们提出LIBERO-PeRM，一个具身智能体偏好学习基准。LIBERO-PeRM研究五个问题：1）策略在零样本设置下如何遵循偏好；2）如何从演示中学习单一偏好；3）随着演示增加，偏好获取效率如何；4）学到的偏好如何跨布局和任务泛化；5）策略如何组合偏好并在冲突下表现。我们提出仿真中可观测偏好的受控表述与分类体系，涵盖运动、技能和用户画像选择。该表述限于可用语言表达、可在LIBERO中实例化而不改变任务目标、可自动评估、可跨任务复用的偏好。基于LIBERO，我们的程序化流水线生成带偏好和不带偏好的配对演示。我们创建五个任务套件（312个任务），包含高质量演示、丰富元数据和偏好满足度指标。实验表明，当前VLA策略在零样本个性化上表现不佳，而

extra.description: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-expressible preferences that can be instantiated in LIBERO without changing the task goal, evaluated automatically, and reused across tasks. Building on LIBERO, our procedural pipeline generates paired demonstrations with and without preferences. We create five task suites (312 tasks) with high-quality demonstrations, rich metadata, and preference-satisfaction metrics. Experiments show that current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot personalization, while SFT makes preferences learnable. Mixed training achieves better no-preference retention than sequential adaptation and improves performance with contextual prompts compared with preference-only training, but can weaken motion-preference learning; preference generalization, decomposition, and conflict handling remain difficult. The code, datasets, and demos can be found on the project website: https://libero-perm.github.io/.

items.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
items.title_zh: FDE-Gym：AI交付的最后一公里
items.summary_zh: 现有智能体基准通常在由问题报告、规格说明或任务工单定义的明确任务上评估智能体。真实客户交付不同：前线部署工程师（FDE）必须澄清模糊需求、在实时系统中工作并发现未明说的约束。我们提出FDE-Gym，一个包含来自18个行业20个客户场景的95个端到端交付任务的基准，每个任务由行业专家从真实交付项目改编。在具有脚本化利益相关者和可修改客户系统的模拟客户环境中，智能体与利益相关者交互并在类生产系统上操作以交付可用解决方案。FDE-Gym根据交付对客户自身成功指标的改善程度评分，归一化在0（系统未变）到1（参考解决方案）之间，并对利益相关者交互（消息、试运行和等待时间）施加惩罚。在线平台让人类在相同评分标准下练习FDE技能。我们评估来自七个提供商的13种模型配置。在现实设置中，必须发现未明说约束，最佳配置取得平均FDE-Gym分数0.56，仅解决95个任务中的14个（分数至少0.8且无事故）。发现

extra.description: Existing agent benchmarks typically evaluate agents on well-specified tasks defined by issue reports, specifications, or task tickets. Real-world customer delivery is different: forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must clarify ambiguous requirements, work in live systems, and uncover unstated constraints. We introduce FDE-Gym, a benchmark of 95 end-to-end delivery tasks from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors, each adapted by industry experts from real-world delivery projects. In simulated customer environments with scripted stakeholders and modifiable customer systems, agents interact with stakeholders and operate on production-like systems to deliver working solutions. FDE-Gym scores a delivery by how much it improves the customer's own success metric, normalized between 0 (unchanged system) and 1 (reference solution), with penalties for stakeholder interactions (messages, trial runs, and waiting time). An online platform lets humans practice FDE skills under the same grading criteria. We evaluate 13 model configurations from seven providers. In the realistic setting, where unstated constraints must be discovered, the best configuration achieves a mean FDE-Gym score of 0.56 and resolves only 14 of the 95 tasks (a score of at least 0.8 with no incident). Discovering unstated constraints is the primary bottleneck: performance drops sharply when models must uncover them without explicit guidance. Yet information discovery alone does not account for the gap: even on the 23 tasks where the best configuration obtains every key fact from stakeholders, it reaches a normalized business uplift of 0.8 or above on only 10. These results reveal a substantial gap between solving well-specified tasks and delivering effective AI systems for real customers.

items.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
items.title_zh: GeoState：学习用于3D世界建模的视角解耦几何状态
items.summary_zh: 近期3D世界模型越来越多地使用几何基础模型（GFM）的特征作为预测世界状态，受益于其丰富几何先验。然而这些特征的视角依赖性将场景动态与相机引起的变异纠缠在一起，使所得状态演化更难预测。我们提出GeoState，一种用于预测性3D世界建模的视角解耦几何表示，将场景状态演化与相机相关观测分离。具体而言，场景分词器将多视角GFM特征聚合为视角解耦场景状态，几何解码器使用相机射线查询。自回归世界模型随后预测未来场景状态，而相机运动单独建模。因此预测状态可在预测或外部指定相机下解码，同时在整个展开过程中保持单一上下文导出尺度，无需逐帧尺度对齐。实验表明，GeoState在Waymo上优于先前3D世界模型，支持几何一致的跨视角查询，并零样本泛化到KITTI和nuScenes。项目页面：https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/

extra.description: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. The predicted states can therefore be decoded under either predicted or externally specified cameras, while retaining a single context-derived scale throughout the rollout without per-frame scale alignment. Experiments show that GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo, supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying, and generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes. Project page: https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/

items.title: AVC-Reward: Event-Centric Audio-Video Consistency Evaluation
items.title_zh: AVC-Reward：以事件为中心的音频-视频一致性评估
items.summary_zh: 随着联合音频-视频生成模型能力增强，它们能生成展现三种复杂性的音频-视觉场景：多事件组合、多层音频混合和非对称跨模态关系。然而当前评估大多复用早期简单单向任务的指标。它们通常将音频-视频片段作为整体评估并依赖简单预定义关系，使其不适合这些日益复杂的场景。我们提出以事件为中心的评估框架，在事件层面解耦音频和视觉事件，独立分析每个事件，跨模态交叉验证关系，并将判断聚合为粗到细的三级一致性指标。该指标评估全局叙事和谐、事件级时间同步和细粒度属性对齐，为跨多样生成设置和跨模态关系的音频-视频一致性评估提供通用表述。我们将该指标实例化为AVC-Reward，一个可训练音频-视频奖励模型。为评估自动判断与人类感知在生成范式和关系复杂性上的一致性，我们构建AVC-Benchmark，主要来自各类音频-视频生成模型生成的多样正负样本。AVC-Reward在自动方法中实现与人类判断的最先进对齐，提供可解释理

extra.description: As joint audio-video generation models become more capable, they can generate audio-visual scenes exhibiting three forms of complexity: multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixture, and asymmetric cross-modal relations. However, current evaluations largely reuse metrics from earlier simple and unidirectional tasks. They typically evaluate an audio-video clip as a whole and rely on simple predefined relations, making them unsuitable for these increasingly complex scenes. We propose an event-centric evaluation framework that disentangles audio and visual events at the event level, analyzes each event independently, cross-validates relations across modalities, and aggregates the judgments into a coarse-to-fine, three-level consistency metric. The metric assesses global narrative harmony, event-level temporal synchronization, and fine-grained attribute alignment, providing a general formulation for audio-video consistency evaluation across diverse generation settings and cross-modal relations. We instantiate the metric as AVC-Reward, a trainable audio-video reward model. To evaluate the agreement between automatic judgments and human perception across generation paradigms and relation complexities, we construct AVC-Benchmark, which is primarily built from diverse positive and negative samples generated by various types of audio-video generation models. AVC-Reward achieves state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment among automatic methods, provides interpretable rationales that localize failures, and improves the audio-video consistency of a joint generation model when used as an online reinforcement-learning signal. Project page: https://tsuki0512.github.io/AVC-Reward.github.io/

items.title: AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions
items.title_zh: AI Consilium：LLM临床多学科第二意见基准
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）可为复杂病例生成鉴别诊断，但有用的第二意见还必须事实有据、临床连贯、可操作且安全。我们开发了一个多维基准，使用300个诊断已解决的NEJM--MedQA病例：110个用于医生参考评分和Judge校准，190个用于留出评估。八种单模型流水线在自由形式和结构化临床推理条件下生成独立角色特定意见和交互式会诊报告。经医生校准的LLM Judge评估3,040份最终报告及相应结构化主角色输出。模型身份比响应格式更能区分报告质量。结构化最终报告在八种模型流水线中的七种具有更高总体平均分，其最明显优势在管理（2.740 vs. 2.436）。与结构化会诊前主角色意见相比，完整结构化综合在所有五个共享标准上汇总分数更高，其中问题优先级、事实依据和推理连贯性提升最大。GPT-5.6-Sol在每个评估组件中领先，并以最少审查轮次达成共识。这些发现表明，该基准能在同一常见病例评估中区分模型能

extra.description: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. Eight single-model pipelines generated independent role-specific opinions and interactive-consilium reports under free-form and structured clinical-reasoning conditions. A physician-calibrated LLM Judge evaluated 3,040 final reports and the corresponding structured primary-role outputs. Model identity separated report quality more strongly than response format. Structured final reports had higher overall mean scores in seven of eight model pipelines, with their clearest advantage in management (2.740 vs. 2.436). Compared with the structured pre-consilium primary-role opinion, the complete structured synthesis had higher pooled scores across all five shared criteria, with the largest increases in problem prioritization, factual grounding, and reasoning coherence. GPT-5.6-Sol led every evaluated component and reached consensus in the fewest review rounds. These findings show that the benchmark can distinguish model capability, the contribution of multidisciplinary synthesis, criterion-specific effects of response structure, deliberation dynamics, and inference requirements within one common-case evaluation.

items.title: Asking Smarter Questions: Targeted Active Preference Learning for Underspecified Rewards
items.title_zh: 提出更聪明的问题：针对欠指定奖励的定向主动偏好学习
items.summary_zh: 奖励学习通常假设人类的输入涵盖了任务中所有重要内容。在实践中，人类一次只能关注有限的内容，因此他们的教学自然对某些特征——或任务的某些方面——的捕捉优于其他。先前工作已表明机器人如何直接从其教学数据中识别哪些特征监督不足。但当前的解决方案是要求人类再试一次，将负担放在已经难以传达这些特征的人身上。我们提出将这一负担转移给机器人。我们的关键见解是，告诉机器人它不知道什么的信息同样可以帮助它提出更好的问题。偏好查询提供了一种低努力渠道来解决这种不确定性，但前提是机器人知道将查询指向何处，且人类知道回答时关注什么。我们以两种方式实践这一见解：我们构建一个知情先验，将偏好查询定向到需要解决的特征，并为每个查询附上解释，将人类注意力集中在这些特征上。在模拟中，知情先验在低查询机制下比标准主动偏好学习基线高出最多 30.8%，而低查询机制正是减少人类努力最重要的场景。在用户研究中，知情先验和解释各自显

extra.description: Reward learning typically assumes the human's input covers everything that matters for the task. In practice, humans can only attend to so much at once, so their teaching naturally captures some features---or aspects of the task---better than others. Prior work has shown how the robot can identify which features were poorly supervised directly from its teaching data. But the current solution is to ask the human to try again, putting the burden on someone who already struggled to convey those features. We propose shifting this burden to the robot. Our key insight is that the same information that tells the robot what it doesn't know can help it ask better questions. Preference queries offer a low-effort channel for resolving this uncertainty, but only if the robot knows where to direct them and the human knows what to attend to when answering. We act on this insight in two ways: we build an informed prior that targets preference queries at the features that need resolving, and we accompany each query with an explanation that focuses the human's attention on exactly those features. In simulation, the informed prior beats the standard active preference learning baseline by up to $30.8\%$ in the low-query regime, where reducing human effort matters most. In a user study, the informed prior and explanations each significantly improve reward recovery and amplify each other.

items.title: X-RIC: An Agentic RAN-Intelligent Controller Benchmark for Enhancing Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: X-RIC：一个用于增强强化学习的 Agentic RAN 智能控制器基准
items.summary_zh: O-RAN ALLIANCE 通过解聚和 AI 驱动控制引入架构灵活性。虽然 RAN 智能控制器（RIC）实现集中优化，但当前 AI 方法缺乏推理能力和可解释性。我们提出 eXplainable RIC（X-RIC），一种将 agentic AI 集成到 O-RAN 架构中的新框架。X-RIC 通过以下方式将反应式强化学习（RL）与策略性 agentic 推理相结合：(i) 使用领域启发式进行自动行为克隆（BC）以实现样本高效训练，(ii) 一个 Telecom Language Model（TLM），一个基于 transformer 的推理模块，提供上下文抽象和可解释性，以及 (iii) 在 Near-RT RIC 控制回路内进行闭环协同适应，实现持续策略细化。为确保部署就绪，我们引入 BARX（Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning for RAN），一个领域特定

extra.description: The O-RAN ALLIANCE introduces architectural flexibility through disaggregation and AI-driven control. While the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) enables centralized optimization, current AI approaches lack reasoning capabilities and explainability. We propose eXplainable RIC (X-RIC), a novel framework integrating agentic AI into O-RAN architectures. X-RIC combines reactive Reinforcement Learning (RL) with strategic agentic reasoning through: (i) automated Behavioral Cloning (BC) using domain heuristics for sample-efficient training, (ii) a Telecom Language Model (TLM), a transformer-based reasoning module providing contextual abstraction and interpretability, and (iii) closed-loop co-adaptation within the Near-RT RIC control loop enabling continuous policy refinement. To ensure deployment readiness, we introduce BARX (Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning for RAN), a domain-specific evaluation framework assessing agentic control across latency, compliance, and determinism metrics. We validate X-RIC on SLA-aware network slicing in simulation and O-RAN-compliant testbed deployments. X-RIC achieves 89% operational cost reduction while maintaining SLA compliance, converging 75% faster with 50% fewer training steps and 46% lower variance.

items.title: Panoramic modelling of single-cell transcriptomes at scale with CellNet
items.title_zh: 使用 CellNet 进行大规模单细胞转录组的全景建模
items.summary_zh: 全面表征细胞多样性对于理解组织发育、识别疾病相关群体和研究与特化功能相关的基因程序至关重要。单细胞分析的进展揭示了额外的细胞特异性转录本和分子关联，然而许多基础模型仅代表这一日益丰富的分子信息中的有限部分。在此我们提出 CellNet，通过在共享图像表示中整合 DNA 衍生的基因身份和测量的 RNA 表达，实现单细胞转录组的全景建模。在跨越 40 个物种的 2.31 亿个细胞谱上预训练，CellNet 在评估队列中改善稀有群体和条件相关状态的识别，同时保持有竞争力的通用细胞表示。它在总 RNA 数据中预测 withheld 编码基因表达和选定的非编码靶标，并在空间测量中恢复谱系特异性表达模式。预测还扩展到跨物种，包括对没有表达预训练暴露的靶标。其基因表示检索已知非编码模块和发育或神经程序，包括从稀疏检测的 RNA 查询中。总之，这些结果确立 CellNet 作为一个可扩展框架，通过日益全面

extra.description: Comprehensively characterizing cellular diversity is critical for understanding tissue development, identifying disease-associated populations and investigating gene programmes linked to specialized functions. Advances in single-cell profiling reveal additional cell-specific transcripts and molecular associations, yet many foundation models represent only a restricted portion of this increasingly rich molecular information. Here we present CellNet, which enables panoramic modelling of single-cell transcriptomes by integrating DNA-derived gene identities and measured RNA expression in a shared image representation. Pretrained on 231 million cell profiles spanning 40 species, CellNet improves rare-population and condition-associated state recognition in evaluated cohorts while retaining competitive general cell representations. It predicts withheld coding-gene expression and selected non-coding targets in total-RNA data, and recovers lineage-specific expression patterns in spatial measurements. Prediction also extends across species, including to targets without expression-pretraining exposure. Its gene representations retrieve known non-coding modules and developmental or neural programmes, including from sparsely detected RNA queries. Together, these results establish CellNet as a scalable framework for interpreting cellular diversity through increasingly comprehensive transcriptomic measurements.

items.title: Deep learning-based virtual perturbation reveals increasing heterogeneity of gene regulatory responses with aging
items.title_zh: 基于深度学习的虚拟扰动揭示基因调控响应随衰老增加的异质性
items.summary_zh: 衰老生物学的一个核心假设提出，随机分子损伤的逐渐积累驱动转录失调（TD），最终导致功能衰退。然而，现有单细胞分析主要依赖静态表达测量，对调控响应如何在单个细胞水平变化提供有限分辨率。在此，我们利用 DKO，一个深度学习框架，从无扰动转录组预测细胞特异性虚拟基因扰动效应，捕捉细胞间调控背景差异，无需重建基因调控网络或匹配扰动数据。将 DKO 应用于来自人类、小鼠、果蝇和秀丽隐杆线虫的单细胞转录组数据集，揭示扰动同一基因的转录后果随年龄在细胞间变得越来越异质，表明基因调控响应变得不那么一致，更依赖细胞背景。此外，我们发现体细胞突变负荷较高的细胞具有更大的敲除响应变异性，将积累的分子损伤与调控不一致性联系起来。在同一细胞群体内，较高影响变异性也与较高衰老评分相关，将转录失调与衰老相关状态联系起来。我们的发现识别出基因和细胞水平上调控稳健性的渐进丧失是衰老的保守特征，将随机分子损伤与细胞调控响应日

extra.description: A central hypothesis in aging biology proposes that the gradual accumulation of stochastic molecular damage drives transcriptional deregulation (TD), ultimately leading to functional decline. However, existing single-cell analyses largely rely on static expression measurements and provide limited resolution of how regulatory responses change at the level of individual cells. Here, we leverage DKO, a deep learning framework that predicts cell-specific virtual gene perturbation effects from unperturbed transcriptomes, capturing cell-to-cell differences in regulatory context without requiring a reconstructed gene regulatory network or matched perturbation data. Applying DKO to single-cell transcriptomic datasets from humans, mice, Drosophila, and C. elegans revealed that the transcriptional consequences of perturbing the same gene became increasingly heterogeneous across cells with age, indicating that gene regulatory responses become less consistent and more dependent on cellular context. Furthermore, we find that cells with higher somatic mutation burdens have greater knockout-response variability, linking accumulated molecular damage to regulatory inconsistency. Within the same cellular populations, higher impact variability was also associated with higher senescence scores, linking transcriptional dysregulation to senescence-associated states. Our findings identify a progressive loss of regulatory robustness at both the gene and cell levels as a conserved feature of aging, linking stochastic molecular damage to increasing heterogeneity in cellular regulatory responses.

items.title: LOCALE: Local-Alignment Embeddings for Noise-Robust DNA Search at Scale
items.title_zh: LOCALE：用于大规模噪声鲁棒 DNA 搜索的局部比对嵌入
items.summary_zh: 搜索 petabase 规模的原始测序数据存储库（如 NIH Sequence Read Archive（SRA））可能解锁仍无法获取的生物学见解。现有序列搜索方法要么扩展性差，要么依赖对基因组变异脆弱的精确 k-mer 匹配，而基因组变异在物种内和物种间都很高，并因测序错误而进一步加剧。我们将序列搜索重新定义为密集检索：我们学习序列嵌入，其内积相似度将局部比对序列排在未比对序列之上。我们引入 LOCALE，一个使用 InfoNCE 目标在生物学信息增强上训练的编码器：父序列的重叠裁剪，用替换、插入和缺失损坏。这种训练配方，而非专门架构，在跨越三种标记化方案的四个编码器中一致诱导变异鲁棒表示，在 10% 基因组变异下将 Recall@R_q 提高 7–39 个百分点。在 50 个 accession 的 SRA 基准上，LOCALE 在 10% 变异下保持 63.2% Recall@R_q

extra.description: Searching petabase-scale repositories of raw sequencing data such as the NIH Sequence Read Archive (SRA) could unlock biological insights that remain inaccessible. Existing sequence-search methods either do not scale well or rely on exact $k$-mer matching that is brittle to genomic variation, which is high both within and across species and is further compounded by sequencing error. We recast sequence search as dense retrieval: we learn sequence embeddings whose inner-product similarity ranks locally aligned sequences above unaligned ones. We introduce LOCALE, an encoder trained with an InfoNCE objective on biologically informed augmentations: overlapping crops of parent sequences corrupted with substitutions, insertions, and deletions. This training recipe, rather than a specialized architecture, consistently induces variation-robust representations across four encoders spanning three tokenization schemes, improving Recall@$R_q$ by 7--39 points at 10% genomic variation. On a 50-accession SRA benchmark LOCALE retains 63.2% Recall@$R_q$ at 10% variation while existing k-mer indexes and DNA embedding methods fall below 35%, and on the full 4,571-accession MetaGraph benchmark (296 Gbp, 2.06 billion vectors) it achieves 4.5x the AUPRC of MetaGraph, the state-of-the-art k-mer index, with a single-node GPU IVF-PQ index retaining a 3.6x advantage at MetaGraph's query latency. Our encoder and training strategy generalize to real biological variance: on a cross-genotype Hepatitis B task, querying reads from one genotype against accessions of another with >8% natural divergence, LOCALE reaches 0.813 Recall@R_q versus 0.518 for MetaGraph.

items.title: AlphaFold3 and Intrinsically Disordered Proteins: Reliable Monomer Prediction, Unpredictable Multimer Performance
items.title_zh: AlphaFold3与内在无序蛋白：单体预测可靠，多聚体表现不可预测
items.summary_zh: AlphaFold3是蛋白质结构预测的重大进步，但其在内在无序蛋白上的表现仍未被表征。我们首次系统评估AF3在无序系统上的表现，揭示出鲜明的二分性。对于单体，AF3的pLDDT分数能可靠预测无序（MCC：0.693），与AlphaFold2相当，并可媲美专用预测器。这种跨根本不同架构的一致性证实，无序预测源自训练数据，而非模型设计。对于多聚体，情况变得复杂。尽管总体表现相当（平均DockQ：0.563 vs 0.571），AF3和AF2通过根本不同的机制达到这些结果。传统结构特征解释了AF2方差的58%，但仅解释AF3方差的42%。用户无法仅凭界面性质预测AF3何时成功或失败。在无序到有序转变（MFIB基准）上，两个模型表现同样好，成功预测最终折叠状态。然而种子方差分析揭示，AF3的失败是确定性的：模型在独立运行中收敛到相同结构，无论正确还是错误，表明刚性结构先验压倒了可用信息。我们的发现

extra.description: AlphaFold3 represents a major advance in protein structure prediction, yet its performance on intrinsically disordered proteins remains uncharacterized. We present the first systematic evaluation of AF3 on disordered systems, revealing a striking dichotomy. For monomers, AF3's pLDDT scores reliably predict disorder (MCC: 0.693), matching AlphaFold2 and rivaling dedicated predictors. This consistency across fundamentally different architectures confirms that disorder prediction emerges from training data, not model design. For multimers, the picture grows complex. Despite comparable aggregate performance (mean DockQ: 0.563 vs 0.571), AF3 and AF2 achieve these results through fundamentally different mechanisms. Conventional structural features explain 58% of AF2's variance but only 42% of AF3's. Users cannot predict when AF3 will succeed or fail from interface properties alone. On disorder-to-order transitions (MFIB benchmark), both models perform equally well, successfully predicting final folded states. Yet seed variance analysis reveals AF3's failures are deterministic: the model converges to identical structures across independent runs, whether correct or incorrect, indicating rigid structural priors override available information. Our findings establish AF3 as reliable for the prediction of monomer disorder but unpredictable for multimers. Architectural innovation alone cannot overcome training data bias. Progress demands disorder-enriched datasets and ensemble sampling, not merely novel architectures.

items.title: CellChain: Benchmarking Cross-Scale Evidence Use for Perturbation Reasoning
items.title_zh: CellChain：基准测试跨尺度证据使用以进行扰动推理
items.summary_zh: 基础模型和大规模细胞扰动数据集的最新进展，推动了使用LLM预测和推理细胞响应的日益增长的兴趣。在此背景下，生物推理涉及跨尺度关联分子机制、细胞响应和功能结果。因此，评估基础模型不仅需要评估其预测是否正确，还需要评估这些预测如何依赖所提供的生物证据。我们推出CellChain，一个基于实验的基准，包含590个生物案例和2，360个匹配的证据条件实例，涵盖基因依赖性预测、细胞因子轴识别和药物敏感性排序。CellChain通过一个溯源感知的证据图连接扰动实验和外部生物资源，该图涵盖分子、通路、转录和表型信息。任务特定条件改变证据覆盖、组成或分配，同时保留问题、候选答案、参考目标和评分规则。在18个基础模型中，在预设目标证据条件下最高准确率分别为57.5%、75.5%和70.8%，且更广泛的证据覆盖并不一致提高准确率。在药物敏感性基准队列上，匹配的参考历史在聚类加权准确率上平均比交换历史高13.0

extra.description: Recent advances in foundation models and large-scale cellular perturbation datasets have driven growing interest in using LLMs to predict and reason about cellular responses. Biological reasoning in this setting involves relating molecular mechanisms, cellular responses, and functional outcomes across scales. Evaluating foundation models therefore requires assessing not only whether their predictions are correct, but also how those predictions depend on the biological evidence provided. We introduce CellChain, an experimentally grounded benchmark comprising 590 biological cases and 2,360 matched evidence-condition instances across gene-dependency prediction, cytokine-axis identification, and drug-sensitivity ranking. CellChain links perturbation experiments and external biological resources through a provenance-aware evidence graph spanning molecular, pathway, transcriptional, and phenotypic information. Task-specific conditions vary evidence coverage, composition, or assignment while preserving questions, candidate answers, reference targets, and scoring rules. Across 18 foundation models, the highest accuracies under prespecified target-evidence conditions are 57.5%, 75.5%, and 70.8%, respectively, and broader evidence coverage does not consistently improve accuracy. On the drug-sensitivity benchmark cohort, matched reference histories outperform swapped histories by an average of 13.0 percentage points in cluster-weighted accuracy. Decision-transition analysis separates corrections, newly introduced errors, and wrong-answer switches, revealing substantial answer changes hidden by small net accuracy differences. CellChain provides controlled comparisons for attributing changes in model predictions to prespecified expansions of biological context, including changes in evidence coverage, composition, and biological assignment.

items.title: From DNA Design to DNA Slimming: Auditable Agentic Discovery of a Deletion-Only Designer
items.title_zh: 从DNA设计到DNA精简：可审计的智能体发现仅删除设计器
items.summary_zh: 紧凑的调控DNA可以释放载体有效载荷空间，减少合成和测定负担，并揭示哪些序列特征驱动预测活性。然而，大多数基于模型的核酸设计器通过替换优化固定长度序列；它们不问现有功能元件中哪些碱基可以被移除而同时保留预测活性。我们将序列精简任务定义为选择精确长度、保持顺序的子序列，同时保留活性。仿照设计基准NucleoBench，我们提出一种精简的定量评估，平衡序列缩减与维持功能。每个精简器必须返回子序列及其源索引，可用于验证精简器是否遵守任务要求。据我们所知，这是该仅删除问题的首个专用基准。编码智能体实证研究助理（ERA）随后在可执行设计器程序上搜索。ERA收到任务提示和一个成功的仅替换设计器GrAdaBeam作为起始程序，并修改设计器以产生GRADASLIM。我们报告五个转录因子结合靶标的留出评估，比较随机、贪心和ERA引导的精简在400和100 bp下的表现。ERA在9/10设置中均值最高。ERA

extra.description: Compact regulatory DNA can free up space in vector payloads, reduce synthesis and assay burden, and expose which sequence features drive predicted activity. Yet most model-based nucleic-acid designers optimize fixed-length sequences through substitutions; they do not ask which bases of an existing functional element can be removed while retaining predicted activity. We define the task of sequence slimming as selecting an exact-length, order-preserving subsequence while retaining activity. Modeled on the design benchmark NucleoBench, we propose a quantitative evaluation for slimming that balances sequence reduction with maintaining function. Each slimmer must return both the subsequence and its source indices, which can be used to verify that the slimmer obeyed task requirements. To our knowledge, this is the first dedicated benchmark of this deletion-only problem. The coding agent Empirical Research Assistant (ERA) then searched over executable designer programs. ERA received the task prompt and a successful substitution-only designer GrAdaBeam as a starting program, and it modified the designer to produce GRADASLIM. We report held-out evaluations for five transcription-factor binding targets, comparing random, greedy, and ERA-guided slimming at 400 and 100 bp. ERA has the highest mean in 9/10 settings. Paired bootstrap intervals for ERA minus greedy are above zero in all five 400-bp settings, below zero in one 100-bp setting, and overlap zero in the remaining four.
